text:
73세 남성, severe dehydration 및 electrolyte imbalance로 입원함.  
BP 98/62 mmHg, HR 112 bpm, RR 24 breaths/min, BT 37.2°C, SpO2 95% on room air.  
Severe diarrhea 확인됨.  
Normal Saline 1000 mL IV STAT 적용함.  
IV fluid resuscitation 시행함.  
Urine output low, 200 mL/8시간.  
환자 drowsy 상태.  
Urine output 30 mL/hour 미만시 담당의 notify함.
